decision: Selected the centroid of City of Franklin parcel 078 07200 (owner Compass Datacenters BNA I LLC in the city's published parcel layer), which contains the city's site-address point for 311 EDDY LN, as the reviewed site locator for TierPoint's Nashville (NSH) data center at 311 Eddy Lane, Franklin.
layer: City of Franklin, Tennessee hosted feature service 'Parcels' (ArcGIS Online organisation of the City of Franklin GIS); layer editing info gives a data edit date of 29 July 2019; native storage CRS EPSG:3857, so the native cross-check is not independent of the WGS84 output

address_point_check.layer: City of Franklin 'Site Address Points' (service Parcels_With_Addresses, data edit date 6 August 2019)
address_point_check.address: 311 EDDY LN (with suite points STE 100, 106 and 112 at the same position)

computed.method: Planar centroid of the WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygon; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid; point-in-polygon tests with shapely.

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Nashville page (version of 3 September 2026) gives 'Nashville (NSH) 311 Eddy Lane Franklin, TN 37064' and describes the data center as 'near Nashville in Franklin, TN'.

The City of Franklin's site-address layer places 311 EDDY LN (and suites 100, 106 and 112) on parcel GISLINK 078---07200, whose parcel record lists owner COMPASS DATACENTERS BNA I LLC and 14.75 calculated acres.

Compass Datacenters' markets page (version of 21 August 2026) refers to 'Compass' 14-acre data center campus in nearby Franklin'; TierPoint's release of 27 January 2017 describes its Franklin campus built with Compass and the original facility opened in 2013; Compass's news item of 8 April 2013 reports completing its first facility in Franklin, Tennessee.
unresolved: The city layers were last edited in 2019; ownership after 2019 is not established by this source, so no owner role is asserted from it.
Williamson County is not covered by the Tennessee statewide property-boundary layer; the county's own GIS was not reached.
